certificate.reason: no discrete-log solve and no factor-base relation is claimed or produced

what_this_is: A POSITIVE CONTROL ON THE SECTION C INSTRUMENT. The offset is added to the RAW S x E table and the whole scoring path is re-run from that table. It measures the instrument, not the proposition: nothing here bears on tail sufficiency in either direction.

P-C2a.statement: at delta/SE = 0 every target reproduces its committed Delta_bar, SE, nu_eff, |t| and verdict to 1e-12 relative

P-C2b.statement: |t| is monotone non-decreasing in delta once delta exceeds |Delta_bar_committed|

P-C2c.statement: NO target returns FALSIFYING at delta/SE <= 1.0
P-C2c.consequence_if_falsified: the instrument fires on nothing and is OVER-SENSITIVE; reported as a finding about the instrument

P-C2d.statement: every target with |t|crit < 8 returns FALSIFYING at delta/SE = 12 under the floor in use

P-C2e.statement: the recovered SE at delta > 0 equals the committed SE to 1e-12 relative at every target; a departure IS the SE inflation AM-14(b) was written to detect

detection_floor.units: multiples of the target's committed SE
detection_floor.note: the ladder's bottom rung. Nothing below 0.5 SE is tested and nothing below it is claimed.

could_not_fail_demonstration.could_not_FIRE: The injection is applied to Delta_bar AFTER the variance decomposition, so SE is unchanged by construction and inflation can never be detected. THIS IS THE EXACT DEFECT AM-14(b) NAMES. AVERTED: the offset is added to the RAW S x E table and se_decomposition() is re-run FROM THAT TABLE at every rung; the recovered SE is compared against the committed SE at every rung and the maximum deviation is reported (P-C2e).
could_not_fail_demonstration.could_not_PASS: The ladder starts so high that every rung fires, making 'detects the injection' vacuous. AVERTED: the ladder starts at 0.5 SE, BELOW every target's |t|crit, and P-C2c declares in advance that the bottom two rungs MUST NOT fire. The control has a live failure mode at both ends.

what_this_does_not_establish: This is a control ON THE INSTRUMENT. It says nothing about tail sufficiency in either direction, and it neither reinstates nor negates the frozen Section C label.
BATCH-a44d08 is not rescored in any respect.
